answer: Every identity keeps a voyage thread: a hash-linked log of signed signal entries. Each epoch the thread must show eight distinct counterparties, or the 65-credit bond burns; any reused signal burns it too. Forging one thread costs 33 credits of bribes, 6 more per extra one, so 1000 fakes cost 3,030,000 plus 65,000 locked. A rented-thread ring fails: each signal is key-bound. Honest agents pay one 65 bond; real work signs itself.
